summary.text: The landlord did not give approval by the 13th. They now say the 20th of December, which is a week late.

quotes.text: The landlord didn't approve by the thirteenth, they now say the twentieth of December, a week late.

summary.text: Because of this, Kemlite's start on site moves from the 28th of December to the 4th of January.

quotes.text: That pushes Kemlite's start on site to the fourth of January instead of the twenty eighth of December.

summary.text: The delay is inside the two-week stage time tolerance, so no exception report is needed yet. Jonas pointed out that it already uses half of the tolerance. The group agreed to watch how much of the two weeks it takes.

quotes.text: It's within the stage time tolerance of two weeks, so no exception report yet.
It's inside the tolerance, but basically it's already using up half of it.
It's inside, and we can um see how much of the two weeks it takes.

quotes.text: The IT director gave us the third and fourth week of January, not the second and third, because the portal team has the second week.

summary.text: The new weeks still work with Kemlite starting on the 4th of January, because cabling can go in after the first fix. There is no clash on the current information.

summary.text: The desk risk is now much lower. The meeting room tables are still open.

quotes.text: So the desk risk is much lower now. Only the meeting room tables are still open.

actions.text: Keep the meeting room tables on watch.

quotes.text: Keep the tables kind of on watch.

quotes.text: Kemlite signed the contract on the fifth. Their site manager is Halim, he'll be at the next board.

summary.text: Grace asked for Halim to bring a three-week look-ahead to the board, so the group can see something concrete. The request should be friendly.

quotes.text: But let's not settle that now, it's a small point.

actions.text: Ask Halim to bring the three-week look-ahead to the next board.

quotes.text: Will do.
I'll ask him to bring the three-week look-ahead.

summary.text: New item: the SCDF fire safety certificate is needed before anyone can occupy the floor. Inspections are booking six weeks out.

quotes.text: We need the SCDF fire safety certificate before anyone can occupy the floor, and inspections are booking six weeks out.

summary.text: If the inspection is not booked by early January, the move-in might not happen on time. This is a risk, not a certainty.

quotes.text: If we don't book the inspection by early January, we might not be allowed to move in on time.
It's a risk, not a certainty.

summary.text: The group agreed the application should go through Kemlite, as they will be on site. Ravi will ask them, but they have not agreed yet.

quotes.text: Kemlite are the ones about to be on site, so it makes sense to me for it to go through them.
I'll ask. I'm not telling you they've said yes, because I haven't asked yet.

summary.text: The certificate application is kept separate from the look-ahead request to Halim.

quotes.text: I'm not adding it to the look-ahead request, though.

actions.text: Ask Kemlite to submit the fire safety certificate application.

quotes.text: I'll ask Kemlite to submit the application as soon as they mobilise.
